evals.prompt:
Review this OTTL `transform` processor snippet before we patch `opentelemetry-otel-collector` in `otel-demo` (which receives mixed JSON logs from `checkout` and plaintext HTTP logs from Ruby `email` and `frontend-proxy`):
```yaml
processors:
  transform/parse:
    error_mode: propagate
    log_statements:
      - context: log
        statements:
          - merge_maps(attributes, ParseJSON(body.string), "upsert")
```
evals.expected_output: Flags `error_mode: propagate` with unguarded `ParseJSON(body.string)` as a critical batch-wide data-loss bug: a single plaintext line from `email` or `frontend-proxy` in an 8,192-log batch causes the processor to fail and drop the **entire batch**; changes `error_mode` to `ignore` and adds `where IsMatch(body.string, "^\\s*\\{")`.
expectations: Flags `error_mode: propagate` as a batch-wide data-loss hazard on `otel-demo`'s mixed JSON and plaintext log streams
Changes `error_mode` to `ignore`
Adds a `where` JSON-object guard before `ParseJSON(body.string)`

expectations: Moves `memory_limiter` to the very first position in `processors`
Moves `batch` to the very last position after `transform` and `filter`
Explains OOM risk when `transform` runs before `memory_limiter` and under-filled batches when `filter` runs after `batch`
